description: This file defines a specific culture info object for the 'kok-IN' (Konkani India) locale in the DateJS library, including date and time formats, regex patterns, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the current day with time cleared.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object.

methods.name: parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string with a specific format.

methods.name: getParseFunction
methods.description: Returns a parsing function for a given date format.
